g.text: Same basal state and prescribed cue · Placement changes retention
Goryachev C = 40; stationary cue T = 300; identical full support 3, native coefficient peak 6.4 and spatial integral 9.6.
The two withdrawal angles are similar (29.6° / 33.5°); the complete fields and complex activity vectors differ.
A: full-ring profiles; grey band marks input support. B: equal scales; circle = withdrawal, diamond = +13,000. C: time is linear near zero, logarithmic later.
Only cue placement changes; withdrawal states differ. Both initial supports miss the half-contrast core, with different small basal tails.
Regional activity does not track site lineage. This selected contrast does not identify a general fate predictor, basin boundary or unique mechanism.
